race.comment: NOSEY NEO (4) has the strongest winning profile after a close fourth in Class 3 company at Cairns, where he was slow to begin yet was beaten just over a length. His previous second in a Class 5 at Ewan adds further substance, and the return to 1200m is backed by a record of two wins at the distance. RED BOOMSHAKALAKA (2) is the danger despite plain finishing positions, as she drops out of BM62 and BM65 races and her latest Cairns run was better than sixth reads, charging home after settling well back. THIRD MASTER (12) rises from BM45 grade and was beaten as favourite last start, but the weight relief, inside draw and solid record at this track keep him right in the contest. MINNIE VEGAS (9) has been runner-up at her past three starts and brings the most consistent recent form, though she has to turn those placings into a win after being beaten just over three lengths at Gordonvale.
